newsitem.title: GERMANY: German SKET rejects lawyer due to lead liquidation.
newsitem.headline: German SKET rejects lawyer due to lead liquidation.

text.p: SKET GmbH, the largest heavy machinery firm in former East Germany, said on Wednesday it could not accept the appointment of Bremen lawyer Wolfgang Wutzke to carry out its liquidation proceedings.

SKET said that in rejecting Wutzke it was acting on the advice of the BVS agency, the successor to the Treuhand privatisation agency, which believed Wutzke did not have enough experience to act as administrator for such a large firm.
BVS, officially the owner of SKET following the launch of liquidation proceedings, said Wutzke's work in previous cases opposing the BVS also made him unsuitable for the task.

SKET management controversially decided to put the company into liquidation on Tuesday, saying workers had forced it into the step by refusing radical restructuring that would have meant it shedding some two-thirds of its 1,850-staff workforce.

IG Metall, the main trade union involved, also said it would oppose the appointment of Wutzke. A federal court in Magdeburg must now decide on Thursday whether the lawyer can be confirmed in the role of administrator.
SKET is to be the subject of a German parliamentary debate scheduled for this Frdiay.
